# Model Evaluation Report

*Generated by `src/generate_reports.py` from `models/evaluation_summary.json`. Do not edit by hand.*

## Evaluation design

- Records: 1044 (Maths + Portuguese stacked); about 662 distinct students (estimated from matching attributes, because the dataset has no student id).
- Split: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True) first fold; groups = student fingerprint. Training 836, test 208; students present in both: 0.
- Preprocessing (scaling, encoding, absence cap, defaults) is fitted on the training portion only.
- Model selection: lowest grouped-CV MAE on the training portion (tuned models' CV score is the best over a small grid and therefore slightly optimistic); classification: highest grouped-CV macro-F1 on the training portion.
- **Train R²** = fit on the training split; **Test R²** = held-out split; **CV** = out-of-fold on training.

## Prediction range

Approximate 95% range = prediction + [-12.6, 12.1] points (from out-of-fold residuals of 'Gradient Boosting (Tuned)' on the training portion (grouped CV)).

## Sensitivity analyses (`models/sensitivity_analysis.json`)

| Scenario (default RF / XGBoost, 5 splits) | R² mean ± SD | MAE mean | macro-F1 mean |
|---|---|---|---|
| Random split (same student can be in both sides) | 0.852 ± 0.062 | 4.52 | 0.846 |
| Student-aware split | 0.850 ± 0.029 | 4.33 | 0.841 |

Under a random split 55.5% of test rows have the same student in the training set. Averaged over seeds this did **not** measurably change the scores, but single splits vary (R² range 0.810-0.892 for the student-aware split), so one test number should not be over-interpreted.

| Scenario (project split) | R² | MAE | macro-F1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| All features, all rows | 0.806 | 4.63 | 0.897 |
| Rows with final grade 0 removed (train and test) | 0.883 | 3.34 | 0.902 |
| Without G1, G2 and grade trend | 0.207 | 11.69 | 0.531 |

Records with final grade 0: 53; all 53 have 0 recorded absences (14.8% of zero-absence students vs 0.0% of students with absences). Correlation of absences with G3: -0.042 with these rows, -0.234 without.

## Clustering (exploratory)

K-Means, k = 4, features: studytime, failures, goout, freetime, Dalc, Walc, estimated_attendance_pct, engagement_consistency. Silhouette by k: k=2: 0.2608, k=3: 0.1935, k=4: 0.2013, k=5: 0.2139, k=6: 0.1967. Exploratory only. Silhouette values below ~0.25 indicate weak cluster structure; k=4 was chosen for interpretability, not because it maximises silhouette.

- Cluster 0: more past failures, lower engagement index (91 training records, 10.9%; mean grade 8.12)
- Cluster 1: higher weekend alcohol, higher weekday alcohol (183 training records, 21.9%; mean grade 11.16)
- Cluster 2: high study time, higher engagement index (167 training records, 20.0%; mean grade 12.41)
- Cluster 3: near-average profile (395 training records, 47.2%; mean grade 11.71)
